nodes.label: .`a failed refresh keeps the previous list and shows the error`()
.`an empty job list is shown as empty, not as an error`()
.`a successful lookup stores the detail and navigates to it`()
.`a rejected lookup shows the message, stays put and applies the snapshot's job list`()
.`a second lookup while one is in flight is ignored`()
.`a scan runs a lookup while the lookup screen is active`()
.`a scan is ignored while the lookup screen is not active`()
.`openDetail reads the target and stores the detail`()
.`openDetail for the job a lookup just loaded does not read again`()
.`a push while viewing a detail re-reads that detail`()
.`a push with no session sends nothing`()
.`a push for another mode is ignored`()
